(a) LPC over speed (KHJ): Short DTP-1(W14-12), DMD-1(W14-3) and DMD(W14-25) to (W15 connector of points 22 or 23) in control station. GT will come in stimulated start. Open PCU LPC connector X1 and short X1-8 & 9 or W14-9 to W15-22/23 or by placing jumper on LPC centrifugal transducer COKH (B & C points), GT will trip. Check voltage across Emg drain valve.

(b) HPC over speed (KBD): Open PCU HPC connector X1, short X1-20 & 21 or short HPC sensor LOKB points B and B. Put start switch to start. Check voltage across dump valve.

(c) PT over speed: Short DTP-1, DMD-1 and DMD in control station, GT will come in stimulated start. Open OPT connector X2 and short X2-5 & 7, GT will trip. Check voltage across Emg drain valve.

(d) GT 1KG Lub oil protection: Switch Off RG CS supply. Short ДTП-1, ДMД-1 and ДMД in control station, GT will come in stimulated start. Open ДMД-1, GT will trip.

(e) GT 2Kg lub oil protection: After 1KG lub oil protection check, short ДMД-1 (W14-3), then remove shorting from the ДMД 2kg (W14-25) and momentarily switch Off and switch On control station. Open ИТУ2 - X1 connector for making HPC connector X1-14 & 16 open, then short W15/21 & U 15/3 or (W 15/21 - U 15/3). GT will trip.

(f) GT Low fuel trip: Switch Off power supply for FBM. Short ДTП-1, ДMД-1 and ДMД in control station, GT will come in stimulated start. Open ДTП-1, GT will trip.

(g) RG Lub trip: Switch off RG EOP power supply. Short ДTП-1, ДMД-1 and ДMД in control station, GT will come in stimulated start and trip with Low RG EOP trip.

Note: For Kolkata class DMD-1 is NO i.e. from connector/CS shorting required. For Talwar and Delhi class is NC - only connector is required disconnection.

Throttle checks: Proceed as follows :-

(a) Start RG EOP.

(b) Clutch GT with RG.

(c) Switch off GT & RG control station.

(d) Short ДТП-1, ДМД-1 and ДМД in control station, GT will come in stimulated start. Switch ON GT control station and then RG control station.

(e) GTs are ready for Throttle checks.
